VERSION 0.7

##########
# BUSTER #
##########

buster-latest-docker-build:
  ARG TARGETPLATFORM
  ARG BUILD_DATE
  ARG DISTRO_NAME
  ARG FOO_VERSION

  FROM DOCKERFILE -f Dockerfile --build-arg BUILD_DATE="$BUILD_DATE" --build-arg DISTRO_NAME="$DISTRO_NAME" --build-arg FOO_VERSION="$FOO_VERSION" --platform "$TARGETPLATFORM" .
  SAVE IMAGE --cache-hint foo/"$FOO_VERSION"/"$DISTRO_NAME":"$BUILD_DATE"

buster-latest-docker-push:
  ARG TARGETPLATFORM
  ARG BUILD_DATE
  ARG DISTRO_NAME
  ARG FOO_VERSION

  FROM --platform "$TARGETPLATFORM" +buster-latest-docker-build
  SAVE IMAGE --push registry.example.net/images/base/foo:latest-buster

buster-latest-build:
  BUILD --platform "linux/amd64" +buster-latest-docker-build

buster-latest-push:
  BUILD --platform "linux/amd64" +buster-latest-docker-push
